scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -framerate 60 -i out/frames/f%05d.png -vf scale=2560:1440:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 12 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/vouch-demo-1440p60.mp4
